relationships.subject: SCN10A rs6795970 homozygous mutation (AA)
relationships.evidence_quote: VAS scores at 4, 6, and 12 h post-operation were higher in the AA group than the GG group (P < 0.05).

relationships.subject: SCN10A rs6795970 homozygous mutation (AA)
relationships.evidence_quote: Patients in the AA group had higher scores on the pain Catastrophizing Scale, PSQ-total, PSQ-minor, and PSQ-moderate compared to GA and GG groups (P < 0.05).

relationships.subject: Nav1.8
relationships.evidence_quote: NaV1.8 sodium channels encoded by SCN10A play a critical role in regulating action potentials in nociceptive neurons, predominantly expressed in DRG and trigeminal ganglion neurons.

key_findings: Homozygous SCN10A rs6795970 (AA) carriers had higher preoperative pain sensitivity scores and higher early postoperative VAS scores.
AA patients used more PCA compressions and reported lower analgesic satisfaction (only 3 AA patients of 200).
